records.outcome: skill-factory applies its deterministic skill package rules to its own work before it changes another package.
records.motivation: A skill package factory that exempts itself can drift from the Mise task graph contract it generates.
records.why_this_path: skill-factory records stable inputs, receipts, schemas, coverage, dependencies, measures, outputs, and rollback through its own Mise task graph before leaving irreducible judgment to the model.
records.expected_effect: skill-factory and every generated skill package share the same checked deterministic boundary.
records.proof: The skill-factory decision policy, Mise task graph topology tests, and CI receipt all exit 0.
records.falsifier: skill-factory requires a deterministic skill package gate that its own Mise task graph does not run.
records.failure_branch: Block skill-factory skill package updates, add the missing Mise owner and test, then rerun the complete factory proof.

records.outcome: Every repeatable skill package operation has one checked Mise task graph path.
records.motivation: The Mise task graph prevents agent skill mechanics from being reinvented or reported without proof.
records.why_this_path: Mise gives the skill package explicit dependency edges, one local and remote entry point, and parseable exits.
records.expected_effect: The skill package runs deterministic checks through one dependency graph.
records.proof: Task graph tests and the skill package CI receipt exit 0.
records.falsifier: A deterministic agent skill job bypasses the Mise task graph or lacks a checked dependency.
records.failure_branch: Block the skill package, repair the owning Mise task, and rerun CI.

records.outcome: Agent skill semantics, causal reasoning, creative choices, and human-sense judgments stay meaningful.
records.motivation: A skill package shape check cannot decide whether domain evidence supports a useful conclusion.
records.why_this_path: The model reads agent skill sources and performs semantic attacks after Mise validates the evidence envelope.
records.expected_effect: The agent skill keeps judgment where programmatic checks cannot establish meaning.
records.proof: A source-to-claim review and agent skill adversarial review survive counterexamples.
records.falsifier: The agent skill passes checks yet remains generic, false, unusable, or semantically unsupported.
records.failure_branch: Reject the agent skill candidate, repair the lowest semantic owner, and rerun its full proof.

records.outcome: Every agent skill primitive serves a source-backed use-case role and motivation.
records.motivation: Agent skill boilerplate can look complete while contributing no domain capability.
records.why_this_path: Current web research and live owners ground the skill package domain map before drafting.
records.expected_effect: The skill package records actors, objects, behavior, failures, proof, terms, and exclusions for its task class.
records.proof: The domain research and use-case policy tasks pass, then the agent skill survives domain-swap attacks.
records.falsifier: An unrelated domain name can replace the agent skill name without making its instructions false.
records.failure_branch: Block the skill package and research the missing domain dimension before editing behavior.

records.outcome: Every skill-factory Mise task graph task has one truthful dependency set and public purpose.
records.motivation: The Mise task graph must prevent disconnected checks, redundant edges, and premature accepted state.
records.why_this_path: Explicit root lists and direct prerequisite edges make the skill package graph testable without nested task calls.
records.expected_effect: The skill-factory Mise task graph runs independent checks together and waits for required proof before mutation.
records.proof: The skill-factory Mise task graph topology tests cover every task and dependency edge.
records.falsifier: A skill-factory Mise task graph task lacks a dependency list, points to an unknown task, or bypasses an owning gate.
records.failure_branch: Block the skill package CI and repair the Mise task graph before any package update.

records.outcome: Every skill package support-file reference has one visible public task route.
records.motivation: A bare skill package path can invite direct execution, bypass its dependency graph, or load context without a defined job.
records.why_this_path: The skill package writing gate requires each support-file reference to share a Markdown block with its owning Mise task while keeping implementation paths private.
records.expected_effect: Every progressive-disclosure path tells the executor which checked skill package operation owns it.
records.proof: The skill package writing tests reject bare support paths and accept a path paired with its owning Mise task.
records.falsifier: Skill package Markdown names a support file without a task route or directly names private implementation.
records.failure_branch: Block the skill package, route the reference through the correct Mise task, and rerun writing and task-graph gates.

records.outcome: The agent skill retains every authorized model capability needed for its real outcome.
records.motivation: A skill package has no value if deterministic orchestration disables the perception, research, interaction, reasoning, or creativity its use case requires.
records.why_this_path: The skill package Mise graph prepares and proves the repeatable envelope while the model uses direct vision, current research, tools, synthesis, and judgment at the irreducible boundary.
records.expected_effect: The agent skill gains deterministic support without narrowing the model work that makes the result possible.
records.proof: Capability-sensitive evals and direct review show the agent skill used required tools and judgment instead of a deterministic proxy.
records.falsifier: Every Mise gate passes while the agent skill omits, imitates, or blocks a capability required for task success.
records.failure_branch: Reject the agent skill candidate, restore the missing capability route, and rerun its deterministic and semantic proof.

records.outcome: Each agent skill invocation ends with current stable Mise maintenance without interrupting its accepted work.
records.motivation: A skill package needs current runner behavior, but replacing the runner during active work can invalidate in-flight evidence.
records.why_this_path: The skill package defers one no-version Mise self-update task until outcome work passes, excludes plugin updates, and refuses to force package-managed installations.
records.expected_effect: Agent skill work keeps one runner version in flight and verifies compatibility after stable maintenance.
records.proof: The skill package records pre-update and resulting Mise versions plus a fresh post-update CI receipt.
records.falsifier: The agent skill updates Mise during active work, selects a prerelease, changes plugins, or forces past package ownership.
records.failure_branch: Keep the accepted agent skill artifact, report maintenance BLOCKED, and follow the package owner's emitted update route.

records.outcome: Each agent skill evaluates the complete official Mise primitive set for its current runner release.
records.motivation: A skill package can miss useful runner capabilities or retain removed ones when its primitive catalog is stale.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill maintenance task self-updates Mise, fetches that exact release schema, refreshes only the catalog, then runs reconciliation and owned-lineage acceptance.
records.expected_effect: Upstream Mise change becomes an explicit agent skill reconciliation instead of a silent behavior change.
records.proof: Agent skill tests extract config, task, task-config, and tool primitives, preserve dispositions, reject stale catalogs, and require current owned lineage.
records.falsifier: The agent skill catalog omits a schema primitive, rewrites domain dispositions, or passes after an unreconciled release change.
records.failure_branch: Block agent skill maintenance, reconcile each changed primitive, rerun the disposition gate, and then rerun CI.

records.outcome: Every agent skill aspect and package primitive has a complete task-owned lifecycle tied to the skill result.
records.motivation: A skill package can create an artifact yet lack safe inspection, update, proof, recovery, deprecation, or retirement behavior.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill lifecycle record scopes all domain aspects and package primitives, then maps every required phase to a real domain task.
records.expected_effect: Every agent skill owner can be found, changed, validated, accepted, restored, or retired without generic CRUD scaffolding.
records.proof: Agent skill lifecycle tests reject missing aspects, primitives, phases, task owners, and domain motivations.
records.falsifier: An agent skill aspect or primitive has a nominal lifecycle that cannot advance or prove its domain outcome.
records.failure_branch: Block the agent skill candidate, repair the missing lifecycle owner at the lowest task boundary, and rerun integrated proof.

records.outcome: Agent skill creation and migration stop before destructive, ambiguous, or externally linked writes.
records.motivation: A skill package planner that reports a collision, symlink, or unknown host owner yet exits successfully can erase work or import bytes outside its source boundary.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill scaffolder refuses every existing target, while the migration plan excludes symlink bytes and returns failure for collisions, symlinks, and unclassified owners.
records.expected_effect: The skill package reaches model-owned change work only after its read-only source boundary is unambiguous and contained.
records.proof: Agent skill adversarial tests preserve an existing marker, reject obsolete force input, exclude linked bytes, and observe exit 1 on every blocked plan.
records.falsifier: An agent skill scaffold overwrites an existing target or a blocked skill package plan exits 0.
records.failure_branch: Stop the agent skill operation, preserve the source, and repair the lowest skill package input boundary before any write.

records.outcome: A skill package import classifies the recognized source subset without treating a package format as a coding agent.
records.motivation: Requiring every known coding agent marker in one source makes a valid single-client agent skill import impossible.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill corpus reports detected clients and detected package formats separately, accepts one recognized subset, and fails when no shape or an unknown candidate is present.
records.expected_effect: The agent skill can import one supported source without inventing absent clients or weakening unknown-shape refusal.
records.proof: Skill package adversarial tests pass a single client, pass a package-only source in the correct category, and reject an unrecognized source.
records.falsifier: A recognized one-client agent skill fails because unrelated clients are absent, or a package format appears as a client.
records.failure_branch: Block the skill package import, correct the source category or marker set, and rerun the agent skill corpus audit.

records.outcome: Agent skill research and domain gates reject false currentness, malformed evidence, and substring-only specificity.
records.motivation: A skill package can look source-backed when its access timestamp is stale or future-dated and can look domain-specific when one-letter terms match unrelated words.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill research gate bounds access receipts to 31 days, rejects future and malformed dimensions, and matches normalized domain phrases as whole words.
records.expected_effect: The skill package fails before model review when its evidence cannot support a current or domain-specific claim.
records.proof: Agent skill adversarial tests reject stale, future, malformed, one-letter, and substring-only counterexamples while current cases pass.
records.falsifier: A stale receipt or unrelated substring lets the skill package domain gates exit 0.
records.failure_branch: Block the agent skill claim, refresh the source receipt or repair the domain phrase, and rerun the skill package gates.

records.outcome: Every skill package Markdown file and every Mise task command shape obeys the full bounded contract.
records.motivation: An agent skill reference over 200 lines or a nested Mise call hidden in a command array can bypass checks written only for one file or one string shape.
records.why_this_path: The skill package writing gate counts every Markdown file, and the Mise task graph gate normalizes text and text-array commands before checking nested invocation.
records.expected_effect: The agent skill rejects the same policy violation regardless of which owned file or supported command shape carries it.
records.proof: Agent skill adversarial tests reject a 201-line reference and a nested Mise task graph call inside a command array.
records.falsifier: A skill package passes by moving over-limit Markdown or nested Mise text into an unchecked shape.
records.failure_branch: Block the agent skill package, split the Markdown or remove the nested call, and rerun writing and task graph checks.

records.outcome: Every agent skill frontmatter block has one unambiguous YAML meaning and typed Agent Skills fields.
records.motivation: A line-splitting skill package validator can accept malformed syntax, silently replace duplicate keys, or crash on values with the wrong type.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill validator uses a duplicate-rejecting YAML loader and checks every specified field type through a pinned parser in the cached Mise-owned uv environment.
records.expected_effect: A skill package fails with a readable diagnostic before ambiguous or ill-typed metadata reaches an executor.
records.proof: Agent skill tests reject malformed YAML, duplicate keys, non-string names, invalid metadata values, and unsupported field shapes without a traceback.
records.falsifier: An invalid agent skill frontmatter document passes, crashes validation, or changes meaning through last-key-wins parsing.
records.failure_branch: Block the skill package, repair its YAML or validator owner, and rerun the cached validation path.

records.outcome: Agent skill plans and lineage attest only portable files owned by the package.
records.motivation: A skill package digest that follows symlinks or includes dependency installs and runtime caches can leak external bytes and change across machines without a source edit.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill walkers reject every symlink and exclude known runtime state, dependency trees, bytecode, and machine metadata before hashing or planning.
records.expected_effect: Skill package source receipts remain contained, reproducible, and sensitive only to maintained source files.
records.proof: Agent skill adversarial tests reject linked files and directories while excluding `.mise`, `node_modules`, bytecode caches, and system metadata from lineage.
records.falsifier: A linked external file or machine-local dependency changes the accepted agent skill source digest.
records.failure_branch: Block the skill package plan or lineage claim, remove or resolve the linked owner, and rerun the source boundary checks.

records.outcome: skill-factory and every generated agent skill minimize context and elapsed time without losing domain meaning, proof, or model-owned capability.
records.motivation: Token cuts and generic speed presets can increase correction rounds, hide stale proof, or constrain the judgment and tools that make an agent skill useful.
records.why_this_path: Each agent skill operation sets a domain-specific context budget, loads one canonical owner by current digest, and derives bounded concurrency and cache keys from its actual dependency and resource profile.
records.expected_effect: The agent skill spends fewer tokens and less time on repeated mechanics while preserving intelligent, flexible, creative, and thoughtful domain work.
records.proof: Agent skill token contract tests, Mise speed contract tests, cold and warm aggregate timings, current skill checks, and semantic review all pass without protected regressions.
records.falsifier: A shorter or faster agent skill path omits required domain context, reuses stale evidence, slows the aggregate, or narrows model-owned tools and judgment.
records.failure_branch: Reject the optimization, restore the last accepted content digest, and rerun the narrow contract plus the integrated agent skill proof.

records.outcome: Every agent skill can route long prompts, other skills, and extensible agentic primitives through Mise only when each item traces to the skill package use case and promised outcome.
records.motivation: Large agent skill shell arguments, unverified skill paths, generic primitives, and generated command strings can truncate input, misroute dependencies, add irrelevant work, or turn deterministic orchestration into unsafe execution.
records.why_this_path: An agent skill request binds to the completed use-case contract, carries prompt content by file or standard input, verifies every referenced SKILL.md digest, and gives each prompt, skill, and primitive a domain role, outcome contribution, relevance reason, and expected proof, while the caller supplies runner authority without a shell.
records.expected_effect: The skill package gets one natural invocation path for relevant model-owned work while keeping request integrity, portability, and semantic authority distinct.
records.proof: Agent skill behavior tests send more than 100000 domain-specific prompt bytes, one digest-bound traced skill, and one traced primitive through a real child process, then reject missing traces, generic traces, outcome drift, stale digests, and request-selected runners.
records.falsifier: An agent skill prompt is truncated or generic, an invoked item lacks use-case traceability, a changed skill passes its old digest, the promised outcome drifts, request data selects its own runner, shell interpolation occurs, or runner exit is treated as semantic acceptance.
records.failure_branch: Block dispatch, repair the request or runner boundary, and rerun agentic-request behavior plus integrated skill package proof.

records.outcome: Every agent skill body gives the executor one ordered workflow from the domain outcome to accepted skill package evidence.
records.motivation: An agent skill can hold correct rules yet still waste time or skip proof when task order, branches, loops, and terminal states stay implicit.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill body uses numbered steps with explicit Mise and model owners, plus plain Branch, If, For each, Repeat, and Stop controls only where they change package action or acceptance.
records.expected_effect: The skill package executor follows one readable path, returns to the lowest failed owner, and keeps deterministic and model-owned work distinct.
records.proof: Agent skill workflow tests verify order, owners, and control markers in the factory and generated body, while semantic review rejects fake branches or loops.
records.falsifier: An agent skill step has no Mise or model owner, a branch cannot change action, a loop lacks a stop condition, or the ordered package flow can skip required evidence.
records.failure_branch: Repair the lowest agent skill workflow step, rerun the workflow contract and skill package checks, and restore the prior body if clarity or behavior regresses.

records.outcome: An agent skill task graph accepts only records that describe concrete package work and evidence rather than a generic scaffold decorated with domain words.
records.motivation: A skill package can satisfy term matching while its Mise task outcome, value, and proof still communicate no domain-specific state change.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill task-graph gate keeps whole-phrase domain matching and also rejects known generic scaffold clauses before graph acceptance.
records.expected_effect: Every accepted agent skill task record tells an executor which domain state, artifact, decision, or receipt the task produces.
records.proof: Agent skill task-graph behavior tests reject domain-decorated generic outcome, value, proof, and motivation clauses while current specific records pass.
records.falsifier: An agent skill task record passes only because it repeats a domain term around a generic progress or parseable-evidence sentence.
records.failure_branch: Block the agent skill graph, replace the generic record with the task's concrete domain result and evidence, then rerun the task-graph policy.

records.outcome: Every agent skill use-case primitive, decision, task disposition, and invocation proof states concrete domain progress rather than generic scaffold prose.
records.motivation: An agent skill can repeat its domain name around generic language and falsely appear use-case-specific across several policy gates.
records.why_this_path: The agent skill uses one normalized generic-clause detector across use-case, decision, task-graph, and invocation receipt validators.
records.expected_effect: A generated agent skill cannot ship package-shaped evidence whose only domain signal is a pasted label.
records.proof: Agent skill behavior tests reject domain-decorated generic primitive, decision, task, reason, and proof records while concrete package records pass.
records.falsifier: Any agent skill policy gate accepts a known generic scaffold clause merely because it contains a configured domain term.
records.failure_branch: Block the agent skill package, replace the generic clause with its actual domain state and evidence, then rerun the owning policy and integrated CI.
